requirements.title: A share can be created with an optional view limit from 1 to 1000, a share created without one behaves as today, and a limit outside 1 to 1000 is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT
Each successful resolve of a share token increments that share's view count by 1, and an invalid, expired or revoked token counts nothing
Once a share's view count reaches its limit the token returns NOT_FOUND, and 2 resolves racing for the last view never both succeed
Listing a memo's shares returns each share's view count and, when set, its limit

The share panel offers no limit, 1, 10 or 100 views next to the expiry choice, and each listed share shows "N of M views" with a limit and "N views" without one, with new strings in the English locale
SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL each get a migration and a matching LATEST.sql, and existing shares keep working with no limit and a view count of 0
